_meta.description: Real Bay Area food recovery organizations. Every constraint below is taken from the organization's own public donor-facing page; `source_url` records where. Fields that the organization does not publish are null rather than guessed -- an unknown constraint must be resolved by asking, not by inventing.
_meta.note: Only general organization contacts are recorded. Individual staff contacts published on these pages are deliberately omitted.

recipients.name: Food Runners San Francisco (an ExtraFood program)
recipients.constraints_notes: Picks up excess perishable and prepared food from restaurants, caterers, bakeries, hotels and corporate cafeterias. 'If you call in the morning a volunteer or our truck driver will come within 1-2 hours.' No published minimum or maximum quantity. Published guidance describes morning requests; after-close availability is not stated on the page.

recipients.name: White Pony Express
recipients.address: 2470 Bates Avenue, Suite D, Concord, CA 94520
recipients.constraints_notes: 'Generally, we require 300 lbs. or more in donations for us to come pick up from you.' Prepared food accepted only if 'properly prepared and handled in a certified commercial kitchen, kept at the proper temperature, and was never handled by the general public at any point.' All food transported in refrigerated vehicles. Prefers fresh, nutrient-dense food; ~90% of what it distributes is perishable.

recipients.name: San Francisco-Marin Food Bank
recipients.constraints_notes: Explicitly does NOT accept 'restaurant food' or 'mixed food and perishables from catered events', nor improperly temperature-maintained food. Accepts food in original unopened packaging and whole fresh produce. Redirects restaurants and caterers to Food Runners (SF) or ExtraFood (Marin). Donations over 300 lbs require advance notice.

recipients.name: Alameda County Community Food Bank
recipients.constraints_notes: Published accepted categories: 'Fresh produce; Shelf-stable/Non-perishable foods; Fresh/Frozen grocery requiring refrigeration or freezing; Baked goods; Meat; Milk & dairy; Cold prepared foods; Bulk foods.' Cold prepared food is listed; hot prepared food is not. 'Every partner agency has cold, freezer, and ambient storage.' Asks donors to confirm acceptance before delivering.
